scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w shared" "npm run start:dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
